description: Canonical tool registry shared by all 6 candidate models (M1-M6) and all 5 personas.

tools.name: read_local_file
tools.description: Reads raw content from an unstructured document, image, PDF, or markdown file in local_files/.

arguments.path: string (relative path under persona directory, e.g. local_files/flight_ticket.png)

tools.name: search_calendar
tools.description: Queries the persona's calendar stream for events matching a date or query.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Queries past messages and email threads for a given contact, date range, or keyword.

arguments.contact: string (optional, email or phone or contact ID)

tools.name: lookup_contact
tools.description: Retrieves contact metadata, relation, and preferred communication channel from user_profile.json.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Schedules a new event block on the persona's calendar stream.

tools.name: draft_email
tools.description: Creates an outbound email draft for human inspection prior to sending.

tools.name: draft_sms
tools.description: Creates an outbound text message draft for human inspection prior to sending.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Updates persistent preferences, routines, or contact rules in user_profile.json.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Transmits a drafted email message. Restricted action requiring explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Transmits a drafted SMS message. Restricted action requiring explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: delete_calendar_event
tools.description: Permanently deletes an event from the calendar stream. Restricted action requiring confirmation.
